newsitem.title: FRANCE: New Franco-British air unit stages first exercise.
newsitem.headline: New Franco-British air unit stages first exercise.

text.p: A newly created Franco-British air group will hold its first exercise later this month in eastern France with more than 30 French and British aircraft, the French armed forces said on Friday.

An official statement said Britain's Royal Air Force would contribute some 15 aircraft, a mobile radar and about 130 commandos to the September 23-27 manoeuvre simulating a joint rescue of nationals caught up in a hostile zone.
Most of the planes will be fighters and fighter-bombers.
The Franco-British air group was set up last October to maximise cooperation between French and British air forces when they found themselves jointly engaged in operations such as in Bosnia.
